audit: Independent visual recheck of 2018 + five 2019 legacy questions

scope.questionSuites: All 84 questions from 2018, plus 2019 HT legacy T2 02/03/04 and NT1 legacy T2 02/03

method: Every unique PNG viewed next to its original au/lo PDF region rendered freshly with pdftoppm; full labels, edges, data, blank-vs-solution state and option order checked.
All 78 image occurrences checked in current JSON prompt/answer/solution context. Repeated context figures distinguished from accidental duplicates.
26 stratified pool PDFs (25 image questions and 1 adapted-version control), all 58 pages rendered and visually read; graph/data/options and printed pool ID compared, not only title/date.
PNG inspection does not claim a fresh full textual review of every no-image question; earlier author and cross-review evidence covers those.
